def schema_drift(expected, actual):
    issues = []

    def add_missing(schema, prefix):
        for key, value in schema.items():
            path = f"{prefix}.{key}" if prefix else key
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                add_missing(value, path)
            else:
                issues.append(path)

    def add_extra(schema, prefix):
        for key, value in schema.items():
            path = f"{prefix}.{key}" if prefix else key
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                add_extra(value, path)
            else:
                issues.append(path)

    def compare(exp, act, prefix):
        for key in set(exp) | set(act):
            path = f"{prefix}.{key}" if prefix else key
            if key not in exp:
                add_extra(act[key], path)
            elif key not in act:
                add_missing(exp[key], path)
            else:
                exp_val = exp[key]
                act_val = act[key]
                exp_is_dict = isinstance(exp_val, dict)
                act_is_dict = isinstance(act_val, dict)
                if exp_is_dict and act_is_dict:
                    compare(exp_val, act_val, path)
                elif exp_is_dict != act_is_dict:
                    issues.append(path)
                elif exp_val != act_val:
                    issues.append(path)

    compare(expected, actual, "")
    return sorted(set(issues))
